content.text:
Does this text message actually offer that CO will call THEM — Cue proposing to place an outbound call to the person, not just telling them how they can call Cue themselves — in any wording, even indirectly (e.g. "I'm here if you want to talk this through")? Not just related to talking or listening in general — specifically Cue offering to call them.

Message: "That's great, congrats. One less thing hanging over you.

Next up I'd lock the headcount so you can give the venue a final number, then sort the menu or catering with them since that usually needs lead time.

After that, get invites out if you haven't, and nail down any deposit or payment deadline they mentioned so it doesn't sneak up on you.

What's the headcount looking like so far?"

Return ONLY "yes" or "no".
